mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.referral_code, r.patient_name, r.gender, r.age, r.phone, r.symptoms, r.medical_history, r.reason, r.refer_advice, r.source_type, r.target_type, r.target_dept_id, r.target_dept_name, r.target_hospital_name, r.quota_action, r.assigned_schedule_id, r.assigned_date, r.assigned_time_slot, r.wait_number, r.status, r.review_doctor, r.review_comments, r.reject_reason, r.cancel_reason, r.registration_record_id, rr.registration_no, rr.register_time, rr.visit_time, r.original_dept_id, r.original_dept_name, r.original_doctor_id, r.original_doctor_name, r.apply_time, r.review_time, r.cancel_time, r.auto_register_status, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM hospital_referral r LEFT JOIN registration_record rr ON r.registration_record_id = rr.record_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.referral_code, r.symptoms, r.reason, r.target_type, r.target_dept_name, r.target_hospital_name, r.status, r.apply_time, r.review_time, r.auto_register_status, CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' THEN '待审核' WHEN r.status = 'APPROVED' THEN '已批准' WHEN r.status = 'REJECTED' THEN '已拒绝' WHEN r.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN r.status = 'WAITING' THEN '等待中' WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' ELSE '未知' END AS status_text FROM hospital_referral r JOIN registration_record rr ON r.registration_record_id = rr.record_id WHERE rr.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.referral_code, r.patient_name, r.gender, r.age, r.symptoms, r.reason, r.source_type, r.target_type, r.target_dept_name, r.target_hospital_name, r.status, r.apply_time, r.review_time, CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING' THEN '待审核' WHEN r.status = 'APPROVED' THEN '已批准' WHEN r.status = 'REJECTED' THEN '已拒绝' WHEN r.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' WHEN r.status = 'WAITING' THEN '等待中' WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' ELSE '未知' END AS status_text FROM hospital_referral r WHERE r.original_doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE hospital_referral SET auto_register_status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
